svg.aria-label: tejas@arch: programmer, low-level nerd. Arch + Sway, Vim. Writes C, C++, TypeScript and Lua. Interested in operating systems, networking, distributed systems, databases, compilers and how computers work. Currently writing a Redis in C++.
svg.title: tejas@arch

text.tspan: code: the hidden language of computer hardware and software
i write software, then take it apart to see how it works.
, anything that shows what the machine is *actually* doing.
c, c++, typescript, javascript, bash, lua
react, next.js, node.js, express, tanstack query, zustand
rest apis, websockets, modular monoliths, crdts, caching
postgresql, mongodb, redis, docker, prisma, drizzle
grinding with claude to impress my manager.
thinking and writing code with my own brain and hands, like people used to.
learning network programming in c++, one syscall at a time.
the world would've been a better place if humans were never born.
